title: Single hieratic sign, London, British Museum, EA 10188 (AKU HT 68216)

object.name: London, British Museum, EA 10188
object.date: Argead (Macedonian) Period, Alexander IV, regnal year 12, Choiak
object.content: Ritualtext im Götterkult (Songs of Isis und Nephtyhs + Ritual of Bringing in Sokaris + Book of Overthrowing Apep, Names of Apep)

source.attribution: Georg Möller, Hieratische Paläographie, retro-digitised by AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 68216

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 68216; AKU grapheme Y0020 (AKU GR 734). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: Y1 (std), Y2 (var). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 538, 538B. Source publication of this facsimile: Möller 1936a. Occurrence: line 15; find place Theben West; writing direction "Zeilen, linksläufig prograd"; sign size 4.2 x 7.5 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Argeaden, Alexander IV., Regierungsjahr 12, Choiak". Facsimile type: Retro-Digitalisat (Publikation), by Georg Möller. Source scan (WEBP) converted to PNG at native resolution, flattened onto white, white margin added.
